evaluation_criteria.label: Business fit
evaluation_criteria.description: Right for this industry, business type and audience — a customer would guess what the business does and trust it.

evaluation_criteria.label: Distinctiveness
evaluation_criteria.description: Stands apart from the category's clichés and competitors; ownable.

evaluation_criteria.label: Memorability
evaluation_criteria.description: Simple, describable in one sentence, easy to recall after one look.

evaluation_criteria.label: Versatility
evaluation_criteria.description: Logo still reads at favicon size, in one colour, and reversed.

evaluation_criteria.label: Visual appeal & craft
evaluation_criteria.description: Balanced, well-proportioned, polished letterforms and colour; no generation flaws (misspellings, artefacts).

evaluation_criteria.label: Story clarity
evaluation_criteria.description: The brand story graphic communicates who the business is and why it matters at a glance.

evaluation_criteria.label: Business card
evaluation_criteria.description: The card looks professional, printable and on-brand.

evaluation_criteria.label: Coherence
evaluation_criteria.description: Logo, story graphic and card clearly belong to one brand.
